newsitem.title: JAPAN: M"bishi to add diesel car output in India by 2000.
newsitem.headline: M"bishi to add diesel car output in India by 2000.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Tuesday it will introduce a 2,000cc diesel engine compact car at the Hindustan Motors" plant in India between 1999 and 2000.
The new production is in addition to Mitsubishi"s planned 1.5-litre Lancer car output at the plant.

Mitsubishi Motors is scheduled to start assembly in the autumn of 1998 at a Hindustan Motors" new plant in Thiruvallur, Tamil Nadu, with a production capacity of 24,000 cars per year, a Mitsubishi spokesman said on Tuesday.
In September 1995, Mitsubishi said Hindustan Motors would initially make the Lancer petrol model and later the diesel model in the middle of 1997 under Mitsubishi"s technical supervision.
The spokesman said volume at the Hindustan in the first year is likely to be 8,000 cars, and is expected to rise to 24,000 units by the year 2000.

The engines for the Indian car assembly are likely to be supplied from Japan initially but Hindustan is expected to produce its own engines as the local content is raised to 75 percent from an initial 40 percent, the spokesman said.
